name: devcrypto
description: Lowercase hex, strict base64url, SHA-256, HMAC-SHA-256, HKDF-SHA-256 and RSA-2048 PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification — the primitives under the member code's offline verification and signed OTA. No Arduino headers, no heap; compiles for AVR, Xtensa and host.
keywords: hex, base64url, sha256, hmac, hkdf, embedded
